Alliance Club Horsens, commonly referred to as AC Horsens or simply Horsens, is a Danish professional football club based in Horsens, Central Denmark Region. Founded in 1994, as a superstructure on Horsens fS, Stensballe IK and FC Horsens, the club competes in the Danish Superliga following promotion in 2025-2026 from the 1st Division, the second tier of the Danish football league system. Both Stensballe IK and FC Horsens has later left the cooperation, and only Horsens fS remains.
